_comment: Guided tour of the updater. Every step points at a real control; the ones that need the user wait for the press (watching a button being pressed does not teach anyone where it is). Update Now is explained but never awaited: pressing it opens a confirmation, and the tour must not lead anyone into an update.

steps.title: What is installed
steps.text: Current version is the ChiSurf running now; the line below it says what the last check found, and the solver line says which package manager would run an update.

steps.title: Look for a newer version
steps.text: Press Check for Updates. ChiSurf asks the update server which versions it offers and compares the newest with yours. It runs in the background; the status line follows it.

steps.title: Pick a version
steps.text: Available versions lists what the server has, newest first. It is empty until a check found some. Open the list and choose a version: the changelog below follows your choice.

await.hint: Choose a version in the list.

steps.title: Read what changed
steps.text: The changes between the previous version and the selected one, from the project's commit history. Scroll it with the mouse wheel; links open in your browser.

steps.title: Startup behavior
steps.text: Check for updates on startup lets ChiSurf look when it starts; Ignore updates keeps it from asking about what it finds. Both are saved the moment you change them.

steps.title: Installing
steps.text: Update Now installs the selected version, after one question: the update closes every ChiSurf window and continues in a separate window, so unsaved work is lost, and you restart ChiSurf yourself afterwards. Answer No to stay as you are. It is greyed until a check has found a version.

steps.title: Packages
steps.text: Package Manager opens the window for the packages, environments and channels of this installation.
